objects.name: Analytic 2082
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a command-line interpreter (cmd.exe, PowerShell.exe) spawned as a child of an Industrial Control System (ICS) vendor application process, where this parent-child relationship is not part of the documented normal operation of that vendor software or directly spawned processes with a command line parameters containing ICS protocol/Application Programming Interface (API) interaction keywords, from a context not associated with documented automation scripts. Operational Technology (OT) operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.
